c74object.name: mUnit.stimulus~
c74object.digest: Generate a repeatable test signal for an mUnit.assert~ capture
c74object.description: mUnit.stimulus~ makes a test signal that is the same on every run: a sine, an impulse, a linear sweep, seeded white noise, silence, or a sound file played once. It starts when the suite starts (trigger auto, the default) or on a bang (trigger manual), at the same moment as an mUnit.assert~ capture, and stop stops it. Everything but the file is computed sample by sample from a counter in gen~, so two runs give the same samples whatever the vector size. Put the unit under test between it and mUnit.assert~.

inlet.digest: bang starts the signal; stop stops it

method.name: bang
method.description: Starts the signal from its first sample (or the sound file from its start). With trigger auto the suite start does this for you; with trigger manual send the same bang to the mUnit.assert~ that captures it.

method.name: stop
method.description: Outputs silence until the next bang.

attribute.name: type
attribute.description: sine at freq Hz and amp; impulse, one sample of amp then silence; sweep, a linear sweep from freq to freq2 over duration ms; noise, white noise from seed; silence; file, the sound file file played once.

enum.name: sweep
enum.digest: A linear sweep from @freq to @freq2 over @duration ms

enum.name: noise
enum.digest: White noise from @seed, the same every run

attribute.name: freq
attribute.digest: The frequency in Hz (default 440), or the start of a sweep

attribute.name: freq2
attribute.digest: The end frequency of a sweep in Hz (default 2000)

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: The same seed gives the same samples on every run and every machine.

attribute.name: duration
attribute.digest: How long a sweep takes, in ms (default 1000)

attribute.name: file
attribute.description: A file on the search path, loaded into the object's own buffer~ and played once from the start.

attribute.name: trigger
attribute.digest: What starts the signal: auto or manual (default auto)
attribute.description: auto: when the suite starts, at the moment mUnit.loadbang fires. manual: on a bang.

entry.name: signal
entry.description: Out the outlet: the test signal, for the object under test.
